scope: Five captured Account pages viewed using view_image; result and owner receipt read. No independent browser/DB execution or source edits.

observations.finding: All five320x900 captures preserve one readable column, generous page margins, clear heading/body hierarchy, and fully visible controls. No visible clipped content or horizontal-overflow symptom in these captures. Korean labels read naturally overall.
observations.task_outcome: Supports Account entry and narrow-screen orientation. Reuse shell/control vocabulary for subsequent native journeys without inferring wide-screen or zoom acceptance.

observations.finding: Primary login and secondary create-account actions are immediately discoverable. Registration describes passkey creation and explicitly says Company/job title are not requested now. Separate term checkboxes and disclosure links retain distinct actions; captured checkbox focus is visibly outlined.
observations.task_outcome: Users can distinguish entering an existing Account from creating one. Checked screenshot does not establish default checkbox state; driver interaction occurred before capture.

observations.finding: Logged-in Account and absence of accessible workspaces are explicitly separate states. The screen does not invent Company membership or business authority. Returned screen is visually consistent with newly enrolled state.
observations.task_outcome: Preserves truthful progress and Account independence from Employment/Company. result.json reports same_account and active_after_login; reviewer did not independently query DB.

observations.finding: A large empty text-input shape labeled 패스키 계정 선택 appears before copy explaining that no name or email entry is needed. It resembles a required conventional login field, while the action begins with the button beneath it. The screenshot contains no visible browser suggestion/picker state.
observations.recommendation: Make the browser-assisted selection purpose apparent before the input and distinguish it from required typed data. Verify both button-driven passkey selection and any conditional browser suggestions with actual browser states. Preserve reviewed passkey/credential behavior; do not replace it with an unowned shortcut.
observations.task_outcome: Reduce hesitation and mistaken typing at sign-in. Severity is a reviewer hypothesis, not measured user failure.

observations.finding: The no-workspace state explains current status but offers only 다시 확인 and logout. It does not explain who can connect work or provide an assistance/handoff route.
observations.recommendation: When actual enrollment/invitation/access owners are available, show the permitted next action or a concrete accountable assistance path. Keep ordinary Account and designated operator affordances policy-specific. Do not add a dead link or imply current enrollment capability that is not implemented.
observations.task_outcome: Let a person move toward useful work instead of repeatedly refreshing without changed authority. This remains a workflow gap, not a reason to disclose unauthorized Company information.

observations.finding: Terms are explicitly labeled 테스트 서비스 약관 and 테스트 개인정보 안내. This is honest for the provided test-only publication seed.
observations.task_outcome: Retain clear test labeling in evidence. These screenshots cannot qualify the eventual client terms publication or legal approval.

observations.finding: Evidence covers enrollment, logout and login using a Chromium virtual resident authenticator. It includes no canceled passkey, missing-device, lost-credential, denied-access, service-outage, interrupted-commit recovery, or authorized workspace screen.
observations.task_outcome: Do not accept recovery or useful business-work completion from this happy-path leaf. Capture and verify those journeys against their actual owners.

evidence_interpretation.result: BROWSER_LEAF_PASSED; three checkpoints; registration/login/logout POST counts; zero external_requests and unexpected_posts reported.
evidence_interpretation.geometry_and_keyboard: result.json reports root/register/account320px reflow and keyboard skip/registration/terms/submit discovery. Screenshots corroborate visible narrow layout and one focus ring, not all keyboard behavior.
evidence_interpretation.owner_receipt: Attests three DB checkpoints, unchanged source, successful driver exit and process cleanup; it is a parent-owned receipt, not this reviewer's independent database readback.

changes_made: Private critique artifact only; no source or product/runtime changes.
decision_boundary: Accept visual baseline for Account entry only. Continue real Company/workspace implementation and explicit recovery evidence; full release remains incomplete.
